faction.refugee-town.refugee.name: Refuge
Drawn to the arcane mysteries of necromancy and the intricacies of golem craftsmanship, Bhemnesh dedicates his life to unraveling the secrets that bind life and death with an insatiable curiosity and keen intellect.
Raises killed enemy creatures into Flesh Golems.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAran.biography: Through her gentle demeanor and steadfast support, Aran fosters a sense of belonging among its inhabitants. Yet beneath her gentle exterior lies a steely resolve; Aran is not one to shy away from wielding her power to crush the enemies of her people, ensuring the safety and prosperity of those under her care.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAran.name: Aran
hero.refugee-town.rfghAran.specialty.des: Casts Ice Bolt with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of target unit.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAreman.biography: Areman’s life has been marked by grief and hardship as a nomad, wandering the unforgiving lands of Erathia. Despite his trials, he possesses an uncanny luck that has seen him through countless perilous situations. With a steadfast resolve forged in adversity, he stands ready to defy fate and carve his own path to victory.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAreman.name: Areman
hero.refugee-town.rfghAreman.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Vagabond or Nomad for each level attained after 3rd level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAria.biography: Aria has never defined violence as an answer, but as a last resort. She focuses her efforts on ways to increase her kingdom revenues, and doesn’t mind using her beauty as a weapon of choice to lead her allies to victory.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAria.name: Aria
hero.refugee-town.rfghAria.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Estates skill.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAzar.biography: Abandoned in AvLee as a child and raised among unicorns, Azar’s path led him to embrace druidic powers before joining Shayan’s kingdom. Rumors swirl of his connection to Nightmares, born from a tragic attempt to resurrect a fallen unicorn into the door to hell, leaving a trail of dark magic in his wake.
hero.refugee-town.rfghAzar.name: Azar
hero.refugee-town.rfghAzar.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Hell Steed or Nightmare for each level attained after 6th level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghKeyvan.biography: Once torn from his kingdom’s grasp by the relentless tides of war, Keyvan found solace in the unity forged with Shayan, as they embarked on their quest to rebuild. Their bond as brothers serving as the bedrock upon which their kingdom flourishes. Most believe he can control the course of battles with a flick of his wrist.
hero.refugee-town.rfghKeyvan.name: Keyvan
hero.refugee-town.rfghKeyvan.specialty.d: Keyvan can cast the Namburbi and Šigû spells at expert level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghKiana.biography: Kiana's unwavering determination has made her a stalwart defender of Refuge against the darkest sorceries. She shields her allies from harm, ensuring that no enchantment can sway their resolve. However, her tyrannical attitude often leads her into trouble.
hero.refugee-town.rfghKiana.name: Kiana
hero.refugee-town.rfghKiana.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Resistance skill percentage.
hero.refugee-town.rfghLeyla.biography: Leyla’s heart burns with an unquenchable hatred for dragons, born from the tragic loss of her family to these fearsome beasts. Her journey has been a relentless pursuit of vengeance against the creatures that brought ruin to her homeland. She seeks to bring justice to those who prey upon the innocent.
hero.refugee-town.rfghLeyla.name: Leyla
hero.refugee-town.rfghLeyla.specialty.de: Enchant army with Slayer at the start of the battle for 1 turn.
hero.refugee-town.rfghMahyar.biography: Mahyar roams the wilderness with the agility and precision of a true marksman. Raised in the shadow of oppression, he learned the ways of the bow to defend the downtrodden and strike back against tyranny.
hero.refugee-town.rfghMahyar.name: Mahyar
hero.refugee-town.rfghMahyar.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Bowman or Sharpshooter for each level attained after 4th level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghMithra.biography: Hidden in woods near the land of Deyja, Mithra combines cunning and sorcery to outmaneuver her foes. Her skills in espionage and manipulation make her a formidable asset to Refuge, striking from the shadows with deadly precision.
hero.refugee-town.rfghMithra.name: Mithra
hero.refugee-town.rfghMithra.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Thaumaturge or Enchanter for each level attained after 6th level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghNiusha.biography: Niusha’s childhood was marked by the chains of slavery until the hand of King Shayan granted her freedom. Since then, she has served as a loyal and formidable warrior of Refuge, her loyalty matched only by her prowess in battle. With her past fueling her determination, she stands as a beacon of resilience and strength, a testament to the indomitable spirit of the freed.
hero.refugee-town.rfghNiusha.name: Niusha
hero.refugee-town.rfghNiusha.specialty.d: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill.
hero.refugee-town.rfghOmid.biography: Forced to flee his burning homeland, Omid wandered for years to escape the cruelty of war. He now dedicates himself to protecting those who share his fate, using his skill to offer them a new beginning.
hero.refugee-town.rfghOmid.name: Omid
hero.refugee-town.rfghOmid.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Overcomer or Survivor for every level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghReza.biography: Reza, forged from the very essence of magic and metal, is deeply marked by his need to comprehend the emotions of living beings, forever beyond his grasp. Tasked with meticulous craft inside the golem factory, amid the clangor of gears and the hiss of steam, a silent longing stirs within him.
hero.refugee-town.rfghReza.name: Reza
hero.refugee-town.rfghReza.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Gold Golem or Diamond Golem for each level attained after 5th level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghShayan.biography: In the crucible of conflict, bereft of his throne and people, Shayan’s spirit remained unbroken. Fueled by a solemn vow to forge a new sanctuary for the left behind, he united others by his vision. Thus, Refuge blossomed into a beacon of hope, embodying the resilience and unity of those who refused to yield to the ravages of despair.
hero.refugee-town.rfghShayan.name: Shayan
hero.refugee-town.rfghShayan.specialty.d: All creatures are unaffected by negative morale.
hero.refugee-town.rfghSierra.biography: Sierra believes that strength lies in alliances among individuals. She is known to travel from battlefield to battlefield, tirelessly seeking allies to join the cause. Her charismatic presence inspires others to embrace her kingdom, uniting diverse peoples under the banner of hope and unity.
hero.refugee-town.rfghSierra.name: Sierra
hero.refugee-town.rfghSierra.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Rogue or Cutthroat for each level attained after 2nd level.
hero.refugee-town.rfghSoraya.biography: Known as the queen of Logistics inside Refuge, Soraya leads her kingdom’s nomadic tribes with unparalleled skill and foresight. With Soraya at the helm, her people move with efficiency, ready to face any challenge that lies ahead.
hero.refugee-town.rfghSoraya.name: Soraya
hero.refugee-town.rfghSoraya.specialty.d: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.refugee-town.rfghYemapel.biography: Native to Krewlord, little is known about Yemapel except for his impressive talents in military matters.
hero.refugee-town.rfghYemapel.name: Yemapel

mod.name: Refugee Town (Refuge)
mod.description: Refuge is a new town created by Yuya that takes its inspiration from WoG's Neutral Town and Heroes3's Refugee Camp. The common point of its creatures is their nonbelonging to the other factions. Thus, this castle sports concepts such as nomadism, motley armies and makeshift solutions. The town also takes elements from the Mesopotamian/Sumerian/Akkadian mythologies. Official VCMI Forum https://forum.vcmi.eu/t/new-town-mod-refugee/5002
